newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen mixed amid weak sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen mixed amid weak sentiment.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to put in a mixed showing on Wednesday amid another session of lacklustre trading, brokers said.
"Retail investors will continue to watch the market. They are unlikely to come forward until there is any market moving news," said Redwanul Islam of Dastagir Mohammad Adil & Comapny.
Brokers said food and textile scrips might fall while shares in engineering and pharmaceuticals sectors were likely to gain marginally on institutional buying.
The DSE all-share price index lost 1.99 points or 0.2 percent to 954.08 on a turnover of 36.4 million taka on Tuesday.
